Usage: astryx hook [options] [name]

List hooks or print hook docs

Options:
  --list                 List all hooks grouped by category
  --category <category>  List hooks in a specific category
  --params               Print only the parameters table
  -h, --help             display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  success
  1  unknown hook or category, or @astryxdesign/core cannot be resolved

Examples:
  # Browse the catalog
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook --list
  # One hook as JSON
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useFocusTrap --json

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/hook
